crop.notes: The 'Sporting Notes' head and the single Allen notice, followed by an unrelated full article 'New School Buildings' about the School Board's Building Committee. Only the first item is about Allen.

ocr.notes: Allen line is correct; the school article has scattered errors ('Phot Sage Was' for 'everything was', 'pen san ink noe delete').

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's sporting notes for December 10, 1892 carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, December 10, 1892, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen's saloon was at 619 Market Street, where he advertised himself as retired champion pugilist of the world
Allen's saloon offered a free concert every evening, advertising that only the best singers were engaged

notes: The Allen line reads like a paid reading notice placed among the sporting news, repeated weekly (see 870).
